thread:
incident-bot: PAGED @oncall — High embeddings QPS on api-redwood-prod, multiple customers seeing elevated 5xxs and tail latency spikes. Auto-mitigation did partial shedding. Alert: embeddings_route_hot QPS=4200 (baseline 600)
anna_oncall: i'm on it. seeing 502s from edge -> inference pool timeouts, retries spiking. Customers A/C and F report errors.
sam_engineer: looks like an integration started hammering embedding calls (tenant A). Can we surgically carve cap by route? prefer not to do global shed.
maria_sre: agree — per-endpoint cap for embeddings_hot and deprioritize rerank. we can lower embeddings QPS for public-route and route over to best-effort.
lee_devops: i can apply a temporary per-route quota. plan: reduce embeddings_hot route qps from 600 -> 100 per node (global carve), disable rerank on non-enterprise tenants, and add a 120s cooloff for retries to reduce retries loop.
pm_alex: any user-visible impact? need to notify CS/AEs for affected customers if we touch enterprise routes.
anna_oncall: target list: public/embeds, public/rerank, tenant-A custom route. tenant-A is top offender.
sam_engineer: commands i'll run if we agree:```/infra quota update --route public/embeds --qps 100 --duration 15m``` ```/infra route toggle --route public/rerank --state disabled --reason "live mitigation"``` and for tenant-A: ```/infra quota set --tenant tenant-A --route embeds --qps 50 --duration 30m```
lee_devops: i'll be standing by for approval. also recommend turning on cached-embedding prefix for public route to reduce origin calls: ```/infra feature enable prefix-caching --route public/embeds```
maria_sre: +1 on caching. also watching latency percentiles. current p95 token latency = 1.8s -> target < 800ms after carve.
anna_oncall: +1 approve for the three commands, start with tenant-A carve. sam, proceed and post outputs.
sam_engineer: executing now...```> /infra quota set --tenant tenant-A --route embeds --qps 50 --duration 1800
OK: tenant-A embeds qps set -> 50 (effective immediately)```
anna_oncall: seeing immediate drop in errors from tenant-A. overall 5xxs down ~40% in last 60s.
lee_devops: applying public embeddings cap now...```> /infra quota update --route public/embeds --qps 100 --duration 900
OK: route quota updated```
pm_alex: CS team pinged about potential blips for free-tier customers, AEs notified for enterprise customers.
maria_sre: rerank toggle next? that should cut a lot of small high-frequency calls.
sam_engineer: toggling rerank on public non-enterprise...```> /infra route toggle --route public/rerank --state disabled --scope non-enterprise
OK: public/rerank disabled for non-enterprise tenants```
anna_oncall: traffic stabilizing. global embeddings QPS down from 4200 -> 1600. tail latency p95 -> 920ms and trending down. still watching a few errant tenants hitting old clients.
lee_devops: we've pushed a temp rate-limit token bucket at edge for embeds: 10req/s per IP to curb spiky bursts (short term).
maria_sre: please add a followup to run a traffic attribution job and blocklist the integration token for tenant-A if it's abusive. ticket# INC-6152 created.
pm_alex: can we schedule a rapid postmortem with product/CS to decide longer-term: quota defaults per plan, adaptive throttles, and better early-warning metrics?
anna_oncall: agreed. i'm handing off to maria for oncall shift at 12:20 UTC. maria — please keep the mitigations for now and escalate if we see >10% customer impact.
maria_sre: taking it. i'll extend the tenant-A carve another 30m and coordinate with sam for a safer rollback plan. leaving notes in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
